new_assessment.coverage_note: All twelve dimensions were reviewed. Reported immediate distress supports S2 and original-service loss supports S3. Relational affection and grief do not establish autonomy impairment. Uneven community continuity does not erase the original interruption.

dimensions.assessment_basis: Children’s grief and loss of the cloud companion are reported. No physical injury, medically significant exposure or treatment consequence is reported for the bounded 2024 shutdown.

Family reports describe immediate crying and grief at the loss announcement. This supports minor situational distress at S2 in the observed episode. Sustained impairment and recovery duration are unknown; no clinical diagnosis or higher band is inferred from attachment alone.
The shutdown removes a purchased companion service. The evidence does not establish deprivation of essential care, liberty or a legally protected opportunity.
The child-facing product and access interruption do not establish an independently evidenced discriminatory decision or unequal eligibility outcome.
No actual confidentiality loss or unauthorised personal-data disclosure is reported as a consequence of this shutdown. Cloud dependence alone does not establish a privacy impact.
The purchase price is not verified net realised loss. Refund and migration outcomes vary; no defensible aggregate USD loss or independently bandable livelihood consequence is established.

Some robots lost original cloud functionality while local continuity was available unevenly. This is assessed as service interruption. Separate irreversible asset destruction or quantified reconstruction loss is not established; the same unavailable function is not counted again as asset damage.

The original companion/learning cloud service ended and households lost an important function. Later partial migration required technical work and external services. This supports S3 material disruption with bounded recovery possibilities. It does not establish essential-service collapse, universal recovery or permanent destruction of every robot.
Company criticism and parental distress do not establish a target-specific materially adverse reliance reaction, lost standing or independently bandable dignitary injury.
Family-level loss does not establish an adverse civic decision, collective information-process disruption or institutional consequence.
No measured ecological degradation or environmental restoration burden is reported. Potential discarded devices are not recorded as realised environmental harm.

The sources establish affection and distress at service loss. They do not report impaired independent relational choice, coerced continued use, inability to leave or loss of human support. Losing an ordinary companion is not, by itself, relational-autonomy impairment.

harm_review.notes: Twelve individual evidence-based dispositions. Positive supported consequence separated from unknown duration, hypothetical effects and system control behaviour. Relational and psychological observations not summed. No clinical diagnosis or invented baseline.
